description: Generate ONE terse value (a few words / one line) for a row, given that row's known fields and a natural-language instruction — the same "Usar IA" column available in Nock. Use for classification/extraction/summarization into a single cell. A question about facts of the row's company or person (sector, products, news, technology, size, funding) first reads the company's site and runs a short web search, and returns its sourceUrl: 6 credits. From the row's fields alone (classify, summarise, translate): 1 credit. evidence says which: web, row_only or none (nothing reliable found). web forces it either way.

instruction.description: What the column should contain, e.g. "the company's main product".

web.description: true: search the web first; false: the row's fields only. Default: decided by the instruction.
